title: Temporary road closure in Ocean View due to police investigation
summary: The Hawaiʻi Police Department is advising motorists of a temporary road closure of Māmalahoa Highway (Highway 11) near the 76-mile marker in Hawaiian Ocean View Estates on Oct. 2, from 9 to 10:30 a.m.
author: HNN Staff
